mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% per annum indicates a restrictive monetary policy environment that increases the cost of capital for equity valuation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 5.0% per annum signals an accommodative monetary cycle, reducing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates an overheating labor market, which triggers central bank rate hikes and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth is strong and UNRATE is low over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts (HOUST) above 1350 thousand units per month signal an economy nearing peak activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as the cycle transitions to contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1350 in late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 index points indicates a manufacturing contraction, which typically precedes negative equity market returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 2.0% indicates robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 2.0 over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint strength of housing starts (HOUST) above 1350 and retail sales (RSAFS) above 700000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending, driving positive equity returns as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST > 1350 and RSAFS > 700000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% per annum indicates an overheated labor market that fuels wage inflation, prompting aggressive central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
